source.prompt: Create a landing page for Ironbridge Fitness, a strength and conditioning studio at Unit 14, Stafford Park 15, Telford TF3 3BB. Named staff: Craig Hennessey (founder/head coach, BSc Sport Science, UKSCA), Priya Nair (conditioning coach, NSCA CSCS), Dom Farquhar (strength coach, competed at British powerlifting nationals), Beth Whitmore (mobility coach, RYT-200). Full class timetable with times and coaches. Membership tiers: Open Gym £38/mo, Unlimited Classes £65/mo (no joining fee June/July 2026), Classes+PT £110/mo (includes 4 PT sessions). Drop-in £14. Student discount 15%.

notes: Specific city (Telford, Shropshire), named coaches with qualifications and specialisms, full weekly timetable with class types and coaches, three membership tiers with concrete pricing, drop-in rate, monthly technique clinics with dates, 6-week beginners block pricing.
